text:
anja: Quick follow-up after the streaming postmortem. We keep seeing handshake timeouts -> truncated streams -> reconnect storms. Need owners and firm dates for fixes. Keep replies short.

mike: I'll own server handshake hardening (ITEM A). Plan: add p95/p99 accept-queue metrics, capture SO_ACCEPT_QUEUE, and put 6s handshake behind a flag. ETA Mon COB.

yara: I'll own client SDK behavior (ITEM B). Add exponential backoff + capped jitter, client max_conns, beta for node/python. ETA Wed EOD.

mike: Hypothesis: kernel accept-queue saturation during reconnect spikes. I'll add per-worker socket counts and a small reproducer.

anja: Detection: runtime should emit a "stream.partial" sentinel when connection closes without EOS. Mike, add that and a log sample.

mike: Will do. Metric = stream.partial_rate.

yara: SDK will expose stream.on('partial') and only auto-retry for idempotent requests. Will post code snippet.

eng-infra: We can provision a 3-shard harness in staging. Please file INF ticket with QPS and duration.

anja: Canary window: Thu 01:00-05:00 UTC. Rollback if partial_rate > 2x baseline or errors +0.5%. Agree?

mike: Agree. I'll add dashboard panels and alerts for stream.accept.queue and stream.partial_rate.

yara: I'll publish SDK beta and paste release notes here.

ci-bot: Canary scheduled -> 3344558000 targeting staging-1..3 :rocket:

anja: I'll draft a short runbook "Triage partial streams" for oncall and start weekly Friday check-ins 09:00 PT until resolved.

mike: ack.

yara: ack.

eng-infra: ack created INF-5010 for harness quota.

anja: Thanks all — ping in thread if blocked. :thumbsup:
